controls.label: Shape
controls.title: Published convex DAMIT model 298, version 2011-02-18, at its original kilometer scale. The shared grid marks unavailable imagery. This is a ground-based shape reconstruction, not a photographic surface or a measured reflectance map. A convex light-curve model constrains the broad outline and cannot resolve craters or concavities. Lighting uses the documented pole and an arbitrary display phase. Two published pole solutions remain; this view uses model 298 at its own calibrated scale.
controls.summary: Shape made from changes in brightness as the asteroid rotates. Gray grid: no surface imagery.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.title: Color shows the original model radius minus a 93.5 km reference sphere. It includes global shape and is not height above a gravitational equipotential. This is a derived view of the same reconstruction, not an independent measured topographic map. Display resolution adds no observational detail.
controls.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
